noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.347 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.403, Score minimum: 0.255

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. magnetization (score: 0.403)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.20 vs bruit blanc 0.38
     - Hurst max: 1.023, Pente FFT: -0.248
  2. fliprate (score: 0.387)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.25 vs bruit blanc 0.38
     - Hurst max: 1.095, Pente FFT: -0.178
  3. flip (score: 0.387)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.25 vs bruit blanc 0.38
     - Hurst max: 1.095, Pente FFT: -0.178

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. localvar (score: 0.325)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.097
  2. energy (score: 0.324)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.101
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.255)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.952
